name: Caddy
tagline: Caddy - The Ultimate Server With Automatic Https.
description: Caddy - The Ultimate Server with Automatic HTTPS.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: caddy:2.11.7
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 443
        published: 48101
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 2019
        published: 2019
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data
        target: /data
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/caddyfile
        target: /etc/caddy/caddyfile
